instructions.base: I want to replace three of my cooking tools for the next time I make this. For the first one I have either the soup ladle on the counter or the small saucepan at the front of the hob in mind. The other two are the utensil I actually use to drain this pasta and the utensil I use to mix it into the sauce afterwards. Match the basic designs. The draining tool should be at least six inches across so I can drain a whole pot in one go. Add one of each separately, not a utensil set.

clarification.canonical_answer: The long-handled ladle on the counter, not the saucepan on the hob.
